Name: Sebastian tweaks
Author: pinzol
Description:
Honestly, there are already a lot of wonderful mods for Sebastian and our boy is perfect as he is, but I've been onto remaking their whole family: Demetrius, Maru and Robin (you can check them all on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/myaccount?tab=files]my mods page[/url]) and I felt it was kinda unfair to leave him out of it, so I gave him a bit of a haircut, did some changes in clothes, did a bit of face shading, cleared up and redid all sprites.

[b]Beach portrait and character sprites included![/b]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/18312/18312-1694964750-358659557.png[/img][/b]
